potions.name: Dashboard Layout with Collapsible Sidebar
potions.excerpt: An app shell where the page itself scrolls: a sticky header that never covers the focused element, the sidebar in its own column or as a drawer on small screens, and a footer that scrolls with the content.

potions.name: Modal Dialog
potions.excerpt: An accessible modal dialog for confirmations and short tasks, built on the project's dialog component or the native dialog element: focus that moves in and comes back, Escape and backdrop rules, a busy state that survives a failed action, and a full-screen layout on phones.

potions.name: Navigation Bar (Responsive) with Mobile Menu
potions.excerpt: A site's top bar with a skip link, links with disclosure dropdowns, and a menu in a native dialog on small screens. It sticks with CSS alone and keeps focused elements in view below it.

potions.name: Pricing Table
potions.excerpt: Pricing plans with a monthly or yearly billing choice: a radio group drawn as a segmented control, prices and savings worked out from each plan's prices, and calls to action that are links.

potions.name: Data Table (Sortable, Paginated, Filterable)
potions.excerpt: A table for browsing records, with sortable headers, a filter field, and pages, and a selection kept across pages with a header checkbox for the page. It stays a real table, with a caption and row headers.

potions.name: Toast Notifications (Accessible) with Queue System
potions.excerpt: A non-blocking toast notification system with success/error/warning/info variants, queue management, auto-dismiss, keyboard navigation, and screen reader announcements. Perfect for user feedback after actions.

potions.name: Landing Page Layout (Marketing)
potions.excerpt: A marketing page from the header to the footer: a header that sticks with CSS alone and turns solid as the page scrolls, calls to action that are links, social proof from the user's real content, and motion that never leaves a section hidden.

potions.name: ESLint Config Generator for UI Projects
potions.excerpt: A comprehensive ESLint configuration generator supporting React, Vue, Angular, and Svelte with accessibility linting, TypeScript support, and Prettier integration.

potions.name: Form Validation Pattern - UX and Timing Strategies
potions.excerpt: When form errors appear, what they say, and where focus goes: errors when someone leaves a field they typed in or tries to submit, never while they type or tab through, an error summary for longer forms, and the browser's checks working with the project's form library.

potions.name: Dark/Light Mode Pattern - Theme Switching and Color Schemes
potions.excerpt: A framework-agnostic pattern for implementing dark and light theme switching with system preference detection, user override persistence, semantic color tokens, and accessibility compliance.

potions.name: Text Input Field
potions.excerpt: An accessible text field on the native input or textarea: a visible label, hint and error text read with the field, required and optional marked in words, autocomplete for personal data, and a character count that never cuts text off.

potions.name: Login & Registration Forms with Validation
potions.excerpt: Sign-in and registration forms that follow current NIST password guidance, never reveal whether an email has an account, work with password managers and passkeys, and keep passwords out of URLs, spell-check services, and plain view.

potions.name: Select and Combobox
potions.excerpt: Choosing from a list: the native select for a simple choice, and a combobox for search and several choices that keeps focus in its input, highlights with aria-activedescendant, and never picks or submits anything by accident.

potions.name: AI Agent Chat Layout
potions.excerpt: A chat layout for an AI assistant: a conversation list, a transcript that stays put while you read, and a composer whose Send button turns into Stop. A message that fails to send stays in the input with a retry.

potions.name: File Upload Component
potions.excerpt: A file upload that works by keyboard, pointer, and drag and drop: a button opens the picker, the whole area takes dropped files without the browser opening them, and each file is checked and listed with its own progress and Remove button, while the server checks everything again.

potions.name: Button
potions.excerpt: A foundational, accessible Button component with semantic variants, sizes, icon-only support, loading/disabled states, and optional link/toggle behavior. Designed to map cleanly into existing design systems via tokens.

potions.name: Blog Layout (List and Post)
potions.excerpt: A blog's list page and post page: post cards whose title link covers the card, an article with underlined links and code that scrolls inside itself, pagination that marks the current page, and sharing without third-party scripts.

potions.name: Tabs Component
potions.excerpt: Tabs that switch panels in place, after the APG pattern: a named tab list that is one Tab stop, the arrow keys with Home and End, automatic or manual activation, and disabled tabs that can still be found.

potions.name: Command Palette
potions.excerpt: A search box for commands in a modal dialog: Cmd or Ctrl+K opens it, the first result is highlighted so Enter runs it, the arrows move a highlight while focus stays in the input, and Escape always closes it.

potions.name: Documentation Website Layout
potions.excerpt: A documentation site's layout: a sidebar that's a sticky column from 1024 px and a drawer below, the article with code that Copy copies, and a table of contents that marks the section being read without touching the URL.

potions.name: Sidebar Navigation
potions.excerpt: An app's side navigation: groups and nested lists, a collapsible icon rail that still names every link, a saved collapsed state that never jumps, and the same nav as a drawer on small screens.

potions.name: Ecommerce Product Page
potions.excerpt: A product page whose gallery and buy box share the first screen: options that say when they're sold out, an Add to cart that is never disabled and points to the missing choice, and a cart request the server prices.

potions.name: AI Response Rendering Pattern
potions.excerpt: How to render an AI assistant's reply as it streams: Markdown, code, tool-call cards, citations, artifacts, and optional reasoning, with a Stop that keeps partial text, errors shown in place, and model output treated as untrusted. Companion to the AI Agent Chat Layout.

potions.name: AI Action Review Pattern
potions.excerpt: A framework-agnostic pattern for reviewing AI-proposed actions before they run: plan preview, risk labels, scoped permissions, approve, reject, and edit controls, undo, progress, and an audit trail.
